cases._arith: M9-F6/A0 ground truth: 3 figures printed health 4 -> hp 12; only figure 0 moved its dial (2 damage suffered); unseen figures 1+2 keep FULL HP (no dial event = dial 0, never guessed from absence). remaining = 12-2 = 10 -> 10/12 = 5/6. The OLD wheel-as-life reading would have said 2/12 = 1/6. Canon group line expects G|DG002|DG002|1|0|3|3|1|4|5/6.

cases.name: p19_causal_strike_closer
cases.comment: M6s-B7 real-game strike law (Player-19 table discipline): the checkbox flip is the END of a turn and now a causal mission-log line. Damage on the objective-named figure arms a pending strike; the hero whose turn closes next is the shooter. MHD-19 can no longer steal it by flipping its (first-ever) box first. Player-21-b (Thomas 04.11): a landed strike now MOVES the objective marker onto the striker/closer - fighting the phase's troops IS objective work; this case's actor flips from empty to Jyn Odan by law.

cases.name: ra_shot_credit
cases.comment: R-A shooter attribution: a GroupDamage that lands while a hero's activation window is open credits that hero ON THE GROUP ROW (|shot=hero|seq|round tail). The objective here does NOT name the group - the shot law stands alone, independent of the Player-19 strike law (expect: no H-row strikes tail). Ground truth: the damage dials are manual (HPTracker.cs), the payload never names a shooter; the open activation window is the only public-causal channel (M10b attribution law, mirror image).

round=2
posture=eliminate
objective=Defeat the rebel cell.
objective_actor=
threat=0
threatseen=0
seq=5

H|Lokaku|Lokaku|0|0|1|2|0|0
seen=Lokaku zone=at:STORM kind=hypothesis seq=4 round=2

cases.name: ra_shot_without_window
cases.comment: No-window, no claim (R-A): damage OUTSIDE any activation window leaves the shot columns unset - canon carries NO |shot= tail. A window opened AFTER the damage must not retroactively credit it, and a hit between windows never overwrites an earlier attribution (there is none here either). Never guess the shooter from absence.
